name: Crown Towers Melbourne
insider_take: Melbourne's crown jewel rises above the Yarra River, where luxury meets the pulse of Australia's cultural capital.
whats_special: Crown Towers Melbourne stands as the Southern Hemisphere's tallest hotel, featuring the world's largest collection of Dale Chihuly glass art outside of a museum. The property houses Crown Casino, one of the largest in the world, and offers direct access to Melbourne's famous laneways filled with street art, boutique shopping, and hidden cafes.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing room on floors 20+ for stunning views of the Royal Botanic Gardens and MCG stadium, especially spectacular during AFL season and Formula 1 weekends.
dont_miss: The Crown Riverwalk connects you directly to Flinders Street Station and Federation Square in 10 minutes. Time your visit during Melbourne Fashion Week or the Australian Open when the city buzzes with international energy, and don't skip afternoon tea at Lobby Lounge with panoramic city views.
pros: Premium location in Melbourne's entertainment precinct with direct access to Crown Casino and shopping
Luxurious accommodations with floor-to-ceiling windows offering stunning city and river views
World-class spa and wellness facilities with comprehensive treatment menu
Exceptional dining options including award-winning restaurants and 24-hour room service
cons: Casino-integrated environment may not suit all travelers
